scenes.tts: Something passes from the notochord into the neural tube. What is it, and how does a cell receive it?
scenes.visual: Title card: Naming the Signal. An arrow with a question mark leaves the notochord and enters the tube. Box 2 of four is highlighted.
scenes.narration: Something passes from the notochord into the neural tube. What is it, and how does a cell receive it?

scenes.tts: The signal got a name in December nineteen ninety-three. Three papers appeared in one issue of the journal Cell.
scenes.caption: The signal got a name in December 1993. Three papers appeared in one issue of the journal Cell.
scenes.visual: Three journal pages slide in side by side. Label: Cell, December 1993.
scenes.narration: The signal got a name in December 1993. Three papers appeared in one issue of the journal Cell.

scenes.tts: They described vertebrate relatives of hedgehog, a fly gene for a secreted signal. One paper was in mouse, one in zebrafish, one in chick.
scenes.visual: A fly silhouette labelled hedgehog, then a mouse, a zebrafish and a chick, each under one page. Credits: McMahon, Ingham, Tabin groups.
scenes.narration: They described vertebrate relatives of hedgehog, a fly gene for a secreted signal. One paper was in mouse, one in zebrafish, one in chick.

scenes.tts: The gene, Sonic hedgehog, was expressed in notochord and floor plate, the tissues the grafts had pointed to.
scenes.visual: The transverse neural tube map, dorsal up: notochord below, floor plate at the bottom, ventricular zone around the central canal, roof plate at the top, epidermis over it. Notochord and floor plate glow gold. Label: Sonic hedgehog, Shh. The graft image from chapter 1 sits beside it.
scenes.narration: The gene, Sonic hedgehog, was expressed in notochord and floor plate, the tissues the grafts had pointed to.

scenes.tts: In the mouse paper, forcing the gene on where it is normally absent switched on floor-plate genes.
scenes.visual: A mouse brain schematic; a patch where Shh is forced on lights up with floor-plate genes.
scenes.narration: In the mouse paper, forcing the gene on where it is normally absent switched on floor-plate genes.

scenes.tts: Next, Thomas Jessell's laboratory put the protein back into a dish. An explant is a small piece of tissue grown in a dish.
scenes.visual: Neural plate tissue is cut out and placed in a culture dish. Label: explant.
scenes.narration: Next, Thomas Jessell's laboratory put the protein back into a dish. An explant is a small piece of tissue grown in a dish.

scenes.tts: In nineteen ninety-five, Henk Roelink and colleagues gave explants the purified signaling fragment of the protein.
scenes.caption: In 1995, Henk Roelink and colleagues gave explants the purified signaling fragment of the protein.
scenes.visual: Credit: Roelink and colleagues, 1995. Two dishes, one labelled higher Shh, one labelled lower Shh.
scenes.narration: In 1995, Henk Roelink and colleagues gave explants the purified signaling fragment of the protein.

scenes.tts: At the higher concentrations tested, explants made floor-plate markers. Lower ones gave motor neuron markers.
scenes.visual: The higher-dose dish lights up with floor-plate markers; the lower-dose dish with motor neuron markers.
scenes.narration: At the higher concentrations tested, explants made floor-plate markers. Lower ones gave motor neuron markers.

scenes.tts: One protein, at different doses, gave different ventral fates.
scenes.visual: One protein icon above two dishes with different colours. Label: one protein, two doses, two fates.
scenes.narration: One protein, at different doses, gave different ventral fates.

scenes.tts: How does a cell receive it? Think of a brake.
scenes.visual: A cell membrane with two proteins in it. Question on screen: how does a cell receive it?
scenes.narration: How does a cell receive it? Think of a brake.

scenes.tts: The receptor, Patched, is the brake. On its own, it holds a second membrane protein, Smoothened, switched off.
scenes.visual: Patched and Smoothened drawn apart in the membrane, joined by a blunt inhibition arrow from Patched to Smoothened. Small label: an analogy, not physical contact. Smoothened is grey: off.
scenes.narration: The receptor, Patched, is the brake. On its own, it holds a second membrane protein, Smoothened, switched off.

scenes.tts: Sonic hedgehog binds Patched and lifts the brake. Smoothened is freed, and the pathway turns on.
scenes.visual: Shh binds Patched; the inhibition arrow fades away; Smoothened turns bright: on.
scenes.narration: Sonic hedgehog binds Patched and lifts the brake. Smoothened is freed, and the pathway turns on.

scenes.tts: What changes is a family of transcription factors called the Glee proteins.
scenes.caption: What changes is a family of transcription factors called the Gli proteins.
scenes.visual: Gli proteins appear in the cell body, with a primary cilium drawn above them. The word Gli is spelled on screen, with the note: said glee.
scenes.narration: What changes is a family of transcription factors called the Gli proteins.

scenes.tts: Without the signal, Glee three above all is cut into a short repressor. That step depends on the primary cilium.
scenes.caption: Without the signal, Gli3 above all is cut into a short repressor. That step depends on the primary cilium.
scenes.visual: Signal absent: full-length Gli3 is snipped into a short repressor at the cilium base. Label: Gli repressor.
scenes.narration: Without the signal, Gli3 above all is cut into a short repressor. That step depends on the primary cilium.

scenes.tts: With the signal, less repressor is made, and full-length Glee acts as an activator.
scenes.caption: With the signal, less repressor is made, and full-length Gli acts as an activator.
scenes.visual: Signal present: fewer snipped pieces; full-length Gli enters the nucleus. Label: Gli activator.
scenes.narration: With the signal, less repressor is made, and full-length Gli acts as an activator.

scenes.tts: In this model, a progenitor reads the balance of activator against repressor.
scenes.visual: A balance scale: Gli activator on one side, Gli repressor on the other.
scenes.narration: In this model, a progenitor reads the balance of activator against repressor.

scenes.tts: One tool switches the pathway off. Cyclopamine, an alkaloid from a plant, blocks Smoothened.
scenes.visual: A Veratrum plant, then a cyclopamine molecule sitting on Smoothened; Smoothened goes grey.
scenes.narration: One tool switches the pathway off. Cyclopamine, an alkaloid from a plant, blocks Smoothened.

scenes.tts: Necessity came from a knockout, a mouse with a gene deliberately disrupted.
scenes.visual: A DNA strand with one gene crossed out. Label: knockout.
scenes.narration: Necessity came from a knockout, a mouse with a gene deliberately disrupted.

scenes.tts: Mice lacking Sonic hedgehog have no floor plate. They lack most ventral cell types of the neural tube.
scenes.visual: The transverse neural tube map, dorsal up: notochord below, floor plate at the bottom, ventricular zone around the central canal, roof plate at the top, epidermis over it. Credit: Chiang, Beachy and colleagues, 1996. Most of the ventral wall is empty and grey, with a few cells left. Label: no Shh, most ventral cell types missing.
scenes.narration: Mice lacking Sonic hedgehog have no floor plate. They lack most ventral cell types of the neural tube.

scenes.tts: Now a sharper test. Suppose Sonic hedgehog's main job is to stop Glee three repressor from forming.
scenes.caption: Now a sharper test. Suppose Sonic hedgehog's main job is to stop Gli3 repressor from forming.
scenes.visual: Hypothesis card: Shh's main job is to stop Gli3 repressor forming.
scenes.narration: Now a sharper test. Suppose Sonic hedgehog's main job is to stop Gli3 repressor from forming.

scenes.tts: Predict. In a mouse lacking Sonic hedgehog, what should removing Glee three as well do to its ventral cells?
scenes.caption: Predict. In a mouse lacking Sonic hedgehog, what should removing Gli3 as well do to its ventral cells?
scenes.visual: Two crossed-out genes: Shh and Gli3. Question on screen: what happens to the ventral cells?
scenes.narration: Predict. In a mouse lacking Sonic hedgehog, what should removing Gli3 as well do to its ventral cells?

scenes.tts: Removing Glee three restores motor neurons and several ventral interneuron classes.
scenes.caption: Removing Gli3 restores motor neurons and several ventral interneuron classes.
scenes.visual: The transverse neural tube map, dorsal up: notochord below, floor plate at the bottom, ventricular zone around the central canal, roof plate at the top, epidermis over it. Credit: Litingtung and Chiang, 2000. Motor neurons and several interneuron classes reappear in the ventral wall.
scenes.narration: Removing Gli3 restores motor neurons and several ventral interneuron classes.

scenes.tts: Removing Glee three did part of Sonic hedgehog's job. That is a double-mutant rescue.
scenes.caption: Removing Gli3 did part of Sonic hedgehog's job. That is a double-mutant rescue.
scenes.visual: Label: double-mutant rescue. An arrow from the crossed-out Gli3 to the returning ventral cells.
scenes.narration: Removing Gli3 did part of Sonic hedgehog's job. That is a double-mutant rescue.

scenes.tts: A rescue shows that two genes interact, not how. Here, the known pathway supplies the how.
scenes.visual: Label under double-mutant rescue: genes interact. Then the pathway chain appears beside it: Shh, Patched, Smoothened, Gli3 repressor.
scenes.narration: A rescue shows that two genes interact, not how. Here, the known pathway supplies the how.

scenes.tts: So much of what Sonic hedgehog does in the spinal cord is to block Glee three repressor.
scenes.caption: So much of what Sonic hedgehog does in the spinal cord is to block Gli3 repressor.
scenes.visual: Takeaway card: much of Shh's job in the spinal cord is to block Gli3 repressor.
scenes.narration: So much of what Sonic hedgehog does in the spinal cord is to block Gli3 repressor.

scenes.tts: The takeaway: the signal is Sonic hedgehog, read through a brake. Next, how does an amount become an address?
scenes.visual: The transverse neural tube map, dorsal up: notochord below, floor plate at the bottom, ventricular zone around the central canal, roof plate at the top, epidermis over it. Box 2 fills with: Sonic hedgehog, read through a brake. Box 3 lights up next.
scenes.narration: The takeaway: the signal is Sonic hedgehog, read through a brake. Next, how does an amount become an address?
